In addition, especially on shady slopes with a smooth ground surface above approximately 2600 m, there is a cohesive layer of coarse-grained, weak old snow at the snow base. This layer is covered only thinly, so avalanches can be triggered by people in this layer.

tendency.comment: The avalanche situation remains delicate. Dry avalanches can be released by a single winter sport participant, including in deeper layers. Backcountry touring calls for experience in the assessment of avalanche danger.

avalancheProblems.comment:

Avalanches can be released easily and reach medium size. Backcountry touring calls for experience in the assessment of avalanche danger.
